irregularity_lane_paragraph: IR-PROMPT-MISSING-LANE-PARAGRAPH (recurrence): the standing prompt again contains no individualized single method paragraph for this parallel session. This preregistration therefore freezes ONE explicit lane (below) before any experiment, distinct from prior in-repo lanes HTCADS-K2 (promoted 2026-10-26), KG2-MGHV and KG2-FVCA-SUBMOD (negative).
lane_paragraph: KG2-ECPU: Effort-Corrected Positive-Unlabeled detectability-propensity reweighting. Standard supervised detectors learn P(catalogued) = P(fault present) x P(detected and mapped | fault, mapping effort), so they reproduce range-front scarp mapping bias ( in-repo evidence: unweighted KG2-FVCA converged 80.68% onto the dense 10GEMSDOE supervised scarp blanket and scored only 0.0440 on blind SGMC-CAL). ECPU (1) estimates a fold-visible-only detectability propensity e(x) from effort covariates ONLY (1 m LiDAR coverage indicator, log depth-to-basement cover thickness, detrended-elevation slope, log TIGER road distance), (2) trains ONE LightGBM detector on the cached 27 sharp subsurface/scarp channels (X_sub minus the 9 regional-blob columns used by HTCADS) with positive sample weights w = clip(median_positive(e)/e(x), 0.5, 4.0) so catalogue positives in low-effort strata (deep basin fill, LiDAR void, low slope, far from roads) dominate the loss, and (3) emits via the shared exact 300 m CELF allocator (htcads.emit_submodular_celf) outside a fold-visible d>2 px collar. No HTCADS physics Noisy-OR pillars, no tip/relay specialist, no LiDAR feature columns in the detector (LiDAR enters ONLY through the propensity).

candidate_hypotheses_ranked.name: ECPU - detectability-propensity reweighting + effort-stratified allocation
layers: Cached stack from gems32.htcads.build_static_feature_stack: X_sub 36 subsurface channels (USGS GeoDAWN DOI 10.5066/P93LGLVQ derivatives + DOE GDR 1391 DOI 10.15121/1881483 derivatives + training_features.tif 19 official bands), detector uses 27 sharp cols (excludes regional-blob cols {20,21,22,24,25,26,27,33,35})

Effort covariates (label-free): lidar_valid_fp (USGS 3DEP 1 m stack coverage), training_features depth_to_base_surf (band 15), det_elev_slope (band 19), external/tiger_road_distance_m.tif (U.S. Census TIGER roads distance)
Fold-visible labels ONLY (cell.visible_full / quadrant-out training domain); SGMC strictly evaluation-only
candidate_hypotheses_ranked.physical_signature: Inverse-propensity-weighted decision boundary: faults that were catalogued DESPITE thick cover / no LiDAR / low slope / poor road access must carry strong subsurface signatures (gravity/magnetic basement steps, hydrothermal demagnetization, MT edges); upweighting them x0.5-4.0 shifts the detector toward those signatures and away from tall-scarp topography.
candidate_hypotheses_ranked.why_catches_unmapped_not_catalogued: Uncatalogued faults are preferentially those in low-effort strata (blind intrabasin, piedmont under Holocene alluvium, LiDAR-void 24.6% swath). Correcting P(catalogued) toward P(fault) reallocates probability mass exactly there; stratified emission (EXP-2/3) guarantees budget reaches low-effort strata instead of being crowded out by range fronts.
candidate_hypotheses_ranked.differs_from_prior_repos: HTCADS-K2 = hand-built physics pillars + unweighted GBDT + tip specialist; KG2-MGHV = dual-head soft-DTI regression; KG2-FVCA = unweighted supervised (failed via scarp convergence). ECPU changes the TRAINING DISTRIBUTION (propensity weights) and the BUDGET ALLOCATION (effort strata), uses a single plain GBDT, no physics pillar fusion, no LiDAR detector features. No focus-9 site (all H19-5 thinnings) does any training at all.
candidate_hypotheses_ranked.named_non_fault_mimic: Conductive playa clays and Pleistocene Lake Lahontan shoreline scarplets concentrated in flat low-effort basins; mitigated in EXP-3 by requiring potential-field ridge support (max of grav_hg, mag_tmi_hg, base_depth_grad stack cols 0/5/10 >= 70th percentile among eligible low-effort pixels) for low-effort-stratum dots, and by clipping propensity weights to [0.5, 4.0].
candidate_hypotheses_ranked.expected_dti_improvement: Uncertain sign on Hide-Recover (withheld truths are by definition detected faults, so de-biasing may not help there); expected +0.005..+0.020 on blind SGMC-CAL if effort bias is the binding constraint. Promotion requires BOTH gates below regardless of this prior.
candidate_hypotheses_ranked.implementation_cost: Low-medium (~15-30 min CPU reusing cached stack)

candidate_hypotheses_ranked.name: Bimodal strike-mode steerable orientation coherence (NNE range-front + NW Walker Lane)
layers: X_sub Hessian ridge cols 1/2/6 + strike fields recomputed from iso_grav/rtp
candidate_hypotheses_ranked.physical_signature: Steerable-filter response ratio between the two regional strike modes; suppress ridges whose local strike is >35 deg from both modes.
candidate_hypotheses_ranked.why_catches_unmapped_not_catalogued: Short en-echelon Walker Lane splays are under-mapped because walk-over mapping followed NNE range fronts.
candidate_hypotheses_ranked.differs_from_prior_repos: HTCADS axial smoothing is strike-agnostic Gaussian; no prior lane used explicit bimodal strike prior. Not selected: overlaps HTCADS pillar-1 ridges, medium cost, and strike of hidden test faults may follow same modes as catalogue (limited blind gain).

candidate_hypotheses_ranked.name: AFDK - alluvial-fan drainage-azimuth vorticity / knickzone tensor (carry-over H-K4)
layers: det_elev (100 m, available but too coarse alone)
candidate_hypotheses_ranked.physical_signature: Cross-strike rotation (vorticity) of ephemeral-wash azimuths + stream-profile knickzones at piedmont slope breaks.
candidate_hypotheses_ranked.why_catches_unmapped_not_catalogued: Low-slip oblique faults in fanglomerate lose vertical scarps but deflect drainages.
candidate_hypotheses_ranked.differs_from_prior_repos: All prior lanes measure vertical step/ridge amplitude, not drainage-azimuth rotation.
candidate_hypotheses_ranked.official_external_source_needed: USGS 3DEP staged products https://prd-tnm.s3.amazonaws.com/StagedProducts/Elevation/13/TIFF/ (free, public domain; host NOT on this sandbox outbound allowlist - verified against session allowlist github.com/codeload.github.com/api.github.com/registry.npmjs.org/pypi.org/files.pythonhosted.org)

candidate_hypotheses_ranked.name: OPERA DISP-S1 InSAR aquifer-compartment phase step (carry-over H-K5)
candidate_hypotheses_ranked.physical_signature: Sub-200 m seasonal poroelastic deformation steps across impermeable fault-gouge aquifer barriers.
candidate_hypotheses_ranked.why_catches_unmapped_not_catalogued: Fully blind playa faults with no scarp and no shallow basement step still compartmentalize groundwater head.
candidate_hypotheses_ranked.differs_from_prior_repos: No prior lane used time-series InSAR deformation.
candidate_hypotheses_ranked.official_external_source_needed: NASA ASF DAAC OPERA DISP-S1 https://asf.alaska.edu/datasets/daac/opera/ (free, CC0; host NOT on sandbox allowlist)

candidate_hypotheses_ranked.name: ASTER TIR silicification + SWIR argillic halo (carry-over KG2-H5)
candidate_hypotheses_ranked.physical_signature: TIR 8.3-9.1 um SiO2 reststrahlen emissivity minimum (opaline sinter / silicified breccia) flanked by SWIR illite/kaolinite absorption.
candidate_hypotheses_ranked.why_catches_unmapped_not_catalogued: Fossil high-T geothermal upflow along unmapped conduits leaves silicified aprons even where the fault scarp is buried.
candidate_hypotheses_ranked.differs_from_prior_repos: Prior lanes used point sinter inventories (GDR 1391), never orbital TIR emissivity spectra.
candidate_hypotheses_ranked.official_external_source_needed: NASA LP DAAC https://lpdaac.usgs.gov/products/ast_05v003/ (free, public domain; host NOT on sandbox allowlist)

experiments_preregistered.name: ECPU-W (weighted) with preregistered unweighted ablation twin C0 (non-promotable)
experiments_preregistered.detector: Per-quadrant-fold LightGBM (n_estimators=135, lr=0.065, num_leaves=31, min_child_samples=100, subsample=0.8 freq1, colsample=0.75, reg_alpha=2, reg_lambda=8, seed 700+fold) on 27 sharp X_sub cols. Positives: 1-px-dilated visible labels in training domain (footprint minus test-quadrant 15-px collar), cap 38k; negatives: training domain minus 3-px-dilated labels, 4x positives. Twin C0 identical with all weights=1 (seed 600+fold). Candidate = weighted model only.
experiments_preregistered.propensity: Per-fold LightGBM (n_estimators=80, lr=0.08, num_leaves=15, min_child_samples=200, seed 800+fold) on 4 effort covariates only, same pos/neg pools; e(x) predicted on all footprint pixels; weights for positives w=clip(median(e over fold positives)/e, 0.5, 4.0), negatives w=1.
experiments_preregistered.emission_oof: Per holdout cell: surface = that quadrant fold's OOF probability (2D), eligibility = footprint & (distance to cell.visible_full > 2.0 px), htcads.emit_submodular_celf(max_dots=37654, marginal_bar=0.0) on full grid, crop to cell bbox (identical protocol to HTCADS lane).
experiments_preregistered.emission_live: Surface = mean of 4 fold models' full-grid probabilities; eligibility = footprint & (distance to full labels > 2.0 px); CELF max_dots=37654.

experiments_preregistered.name: ECPU-WS (weighted + effort-stratified allocation)
experiments_preregistered.detector: Identical weighted OOF/live surfaces as EXP-1 (no retraining).
experiments_preregistered.emission: Effort score = live/per-cell propensity surface e(x) (per-cell: that fold's propensity). Strata by terciles of e over eligible pixels. Budget caps: high-effort 40% (15062), mid 35% (13179), low 25% (9413) of 37654. CELF run per stratum on stratum-restricted eligibility; dots = union. Same per-cell cropping for OOF.

experiments_preregistered.name: ECPU-WSR (weighted + stratified + low-effort potential-field ridge gate)
experiments_preregistered.emission: As EXP-2, plus low-effort stratum eligibility additionally requires ridge_support = max(X_sub cols 0 grav_hg, 5 mag_tmi_hg, 10 base_depth_grad) >= 70th percentile of ridge_support over eligible low-effort pixels (computed per emission, label-free).

Failing either => verdict negative, DO NOT SUBMIT new file.
promotion_gates_fail_closed.gate5_metadata: Unique timestamp+hash filename; DrivenData note <= 140 chars; <=3 promotable experiments; <=2 h experiment wall time

selection_rule_frozen_pre_experiment: Among EXP-1..3, select the experiment with the highest HIDE-RECOVER-v3.0 OOF pooled DTI among those passing Gate 3 uniqueness; tie-break by SGMC-CAL. The unweighted twin C0 is a non-promotable ablation control and can never be selected. Selection does NOT override Gate 4: if the selected experiment fails Gate 4, verdict=negative and no new file is promoted.
